name: @w6w-apps/productive
description: Productive.io project and agency management: projects, tasks, boards, to-dos, comments, people, companies, deals and budgets, time entries, bookings, invoices, Docs pages and webhooks.

w6w.longDescription:
Productive.io is project, resource and financial management for agencies and professional-services teams. This app drives its REST API from a workflow: create and update projects, tasks and task lists, keep to-do checklists and comments, and read people, companies and Docs pages.

It also covers the money side: deals and budgets, the services inside a budget, time entries logged against them, resource bookings, and invoices (read), plus webhooks so a workflow can react to Productive events.

Authentication is a personal API token (X-Auth-Token) together with the numeric organization id (X-Organization-Id). The token acts as its owner, so what a workflow can see and change follows that person's role. Lists return flattened resources with the vendor's page metadata and a cursor for the next page.
